# Component catalogue

Every registered component, by kind. Use the name in YAML (`name` or `{name: params}`) or in Python (`Pipeline(blockers=[{"tfidf_char": {"top_n": 20}}])`). Components from optional extras appear only when their dependencies are installed.

## normalizers

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ampersand` | `columns`, `output` | Replace `&` with `and`. |
| `chain` | `columns`, `output`, `steps` | Configurable chain: `chain: {steps: [lowercase, expand_abbreviations]}`. |
| `default_text` | `columns`, `output` | strip_whitespace, fold_accents, lowercase, ampersand, remove_punctuation -> `name_norm`. |
| `expand_abbreviations` | `columns`, `output`, `table` | Whole-token replacement from a table (`intl` -> `international`). |
| `fold_accents` | `columns`, `output` | NFKD decomposition, then drop combining marks (no dependency). |
| `lowercase` | `columns`, `output` | Lower-case (casefold-like via `str.lower`). |
| `name_parser` | `columns`, `output`, `tables`, `merge`, `country_column` | Parse names into base name, legal form, designators and qualifiers. |
| `remove_punctuation` | `columns`, `output`, `pattern` | Replace characters matching `pattern` with a space, then collapse whitespace. |
| `remove_stopwords` | `columns`, `output`, `languages`, `table` | Drop whole-token stopwords of the given languages (keeps the name if all would go). |
| `strip_whitespace` | `columns`, `output` | Trim and collapse runs of whitespace. |
| `transliterate` | `columns`, `output` | Transliterate non-Latin scripts to ASCII with `anyascii` (extra `[normalize]`). |

## blockers

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brute_force` | `scorer`, `threshold`, `batch_size`, `n_workers`, `kwargs` | All pairs with `scorer >= threshold` via batched `cdist`; score is `score / 100`. |
| `embedding` | `encoder`, `model`, `text_template`, `prefix`, `batch_size`, `index`, `hnsw`, `faiss`, `top_k`, `min_cosine`, `cache_dir`, `encoder_params`, `kwargs` | Cosine nearest neighbours of text embeddings (hnswlib, faiss IVF-PQ, or exact numpy). |
| `exact` | `keys`, `normalizers`, `max_key_freq`, `kwargs` | Pairs of records sharing a normalised key value (id codes, LEI, domain, phone). |
| `minhash` | `shingle`, `k`, `num_perm`, `threshold`, `seed`, `verify`, `kwargs` | Jaccard-similar records via MinHash LSH over character or word shingles. |
| `phonetic` | `algorithm`, `tokens`, `n`, `max_block_size`, `kwargs` | Records sharing a Double Metaphone code of one of their `n` tokens. |
| `tfidf_char` | `analyzer`, `ngram_range`, `min_df`, `sublinear_tf`, `dtype`, `top_n`, `threshold`, `chunk_size`, `n_threads`, `kwargs` | Top-n cosine neighbours over character n-gram TF-IDF vectors. |
| `token_index` | `min_token_len`, `max_df`, `max_df_ratio`, `stopwords`, `top_k`, `min_score`, `kwargs` | Candidates sharing rare tokens, scored by the sum of IDF over shared tokens. |

## comparators

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `country_match` | `column`, `left`, `right`, `lat`, `lon`, `feature` | 1 for the same country (case-insensitive), 0 for different, NaN when missing. |
| `designator_check` | `feature` | Category ok/review/reject from the name_parser designator columns. |
| `exact` | `column`, `left`, `right`, `feature` | 1 when both values are equal, 0 when different, NaN when either is null or blank. |
| `grade` | `source`, `bands`, `feature` | One-letter grade of an existing feature: A (same), B (similar), F (different), Z (missing). |
| `legal_form_compat` | `equivalent`, `column`, `left`, `right`, `feature` | Category same, equivalent (same group in `equivalent`), different or missing. |
| `match_grade` | `features`, `bands`, `feature` | Concatenate the grades of several features into one string column `f_match_grade`. |
| `numeric_rel_diff` | `column`, `left`, `right`, `feature` | `\|a - b\| / max(\|a\|, \|b\|)`; NaN when either is null or both are 0. |
| `string_sim` | `fn`, `left`, `right`, `workers`, `scale`, `feature` | Pairwise string similarity in [0, 1]; null or blank on either side gives NaN. |
| `token_idf_overlap` | `left`, `right`, `feature` | IDF-weighted Jaccard of the token sets, in [0, 1]; NaN when a side is blank. |

## scorers

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feature` | `name` | `score = f_<name>` (used by the legacy path). |
| `fellegi_sunter` | `levels`, `prior`, `estimate_u`, `u_sample_size`, `max_iter`, `tol`, `comparators`, `random_state` | Posterior match probability from per-level match (m) and non-match (u) probabilities. |
| `grade_table` | `path`, `column`, `default`, `table` | Look up `f_match_grade` in a CSV `grade_pattern, confidence` (confidence 0-10). |
| `model` | `estimator`, `features` | `score = estimator.predict_proba(features)[:, 1]`. |
| `weighted` | `weights`, `maps`, `missing` | `score = sum(w * f) / sum(w)` over the features present for each pair. |

## routers

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rule` | `rules`, `then` | Declarative rules first (first match wins), then a fallback router. |
| `threshold` | `accept_above`, `reject_below`, `on` | Route on a score column: >= accept_above accept, < reject_below reject, else review. |

## validators

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `llm` | `provider`, `prompt`, `parser`, `policy`, `batch_size`, `n_workers`, `scope`, `metadata_columns`, `instructions`, `cache`, `checkpoint_every_n_batches`, `include_features`, `parsed_columns`, `temperature`, `max_tokens` | Ask an LLM about candidate pairs. `__call__` returns `decision`, `decision_prob` |

## clusterers

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `components` | `args`, `kwargs` | Connected components of the match graph (scipy, networkx fallback). |
| `guarded` | `max_size`, `strategy`, `min_edge_score`, `resolution`, `random_state` | Connected components with a size guard (drop_weakest, louvain or flag). |
| `louvain` | `resolution`, `random_state` | Split each connected component into Louvain communities (weight = score). |

## consolidators

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `llm` | `config` | LLM consolidation (wraps `LLMConsolidationEngine`); the engine is built on first call. |
| `rules` | `config` | Priority-rule consolidation (wraps `ConsolidationEngine`). |

| --- | --- | --- |

| `callable` | `fn`, `model`, `kw` | `fn(messages, [schema=, temperature=, max_tokens=])` -> str \| dict \| ProviderResponse. |
| `databricks` | `endpoint`, `host`, `token`, `mode`, `structured`, `request_template`, `response_path`, `client`, `post`, `kw` | Subclasses implement `_complete`; `complete` adds rate limiting and retries. |
| `fake` | `responses`, `model`, `kw` | Cycle through `responses`; an Exception instance (or class) is raised, a callable |
| `openai` | `model`, `api_key`, `base_url`, `structured`, `client`, `kw` | Subclasses implement `_complete`; `complete` adds rate limiting and retries. |

## parsers

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `json_decisions` | `args`, `kwargs` | Parse `{"decisions": [{pair_index, is_duplicate, confidence?, reason?}]}`. |
| `probabilities` | `positive_label` | Read `response.probabilities` of a classifier endpoint (one pair per call). |

## hooks

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checkpoint` | `checkpointer` | Cache pair-producing stages through a FileCheckpointer / DatabaseCheckpointer. |
| `logging` | `level` | Log rows in/out and seconds per stage. |
| `mlflow` | `experiment` | Log flattened config as params, stats as metrics and a 1,000-row pairs sample. |
| `progress` | `total_stages` | tqdm bar advancing one step per stage. |

## encoders

| Name | Parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callable` | `fn` | Wrap `fn(list[str]) -> array` as an encoder. |
| `databricks_embeddings` | `endpoint`, `batch_size` | Embeddings from a Databricks model-serving endpoint (needs `mlflow`). |
| `sentence_transformers` | `model`, `batch_size`, `device` | `encode(texts) -> float32 unit vectors` with a sentence-transformers model. |
